# geordi

**Tag**: web, cli

## 简介

Collection of command line tools we use in our daily work with Ruby, Rails and Linux at makandra.

## 官网

- 主页: https://makandra.com
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/makandra/geordi
- 更新日志: https://github.com/makandra/geordi/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/makandra/geordi/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/geordi
